newsitem.title: USA: Strouds September same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Strouds September same-store sales up.

text.p: Strouds Inc Thursday said it had sales of about $20.1 million for the five week period ended October 5, compared with $19.1 million for the same period last year, with comparable store sales for the September 1996 period up by approximately 2.7 percent.

Net sales for the 31 weeks ended October 5, 1996 were approximately $116.1 million, compared with approximately $104.9 million for the same period last year. Year-to-date comparable store sales increased by approximately 2.2 percent.
